resources.string: Automatic reduces interface animation and glass effects on devices with up to 3 GiB of RAM. Full preserves your appearance choices. Video quality and player settings stay unchanged.
Optional measurement while the app is visible. Stores only a recent summary in memory; measures interface frames and input queue delay, not video frame loss.
